(Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material by exposing the shed cellular material to a non-destructive medium; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos that retain viability during the analysis.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a quiescent condition prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping using PCR-based techniques.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on their analyzed genotype for breeding purposes.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos in a controlled environment. 

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is performed using automated techniques.
